----- PreGame input file prep for RNA-only model -----

Input file needed for PreGame:
a cell matrix (each row is a barcode/cell, either a .csv or .tsv) from each dataset containing:
- Barcode
- "S.Score”, “G2M.Score” and “Phase” values (from Seurat’s CellCycleScoring() function) 
- Normalized gene expression of the 19 PreGame genes 

Outline:
1. Load CD8T obj, subset "NK/gdT", & prepare barcode
2. Normalize CD8T obj 
3. Cell Cycle Scoring (missing ABHD17A & TRDV1)
4. Builds the expression table from the SCT assay
5. Combines the expression with the barcodes and cell-cycle scores 
6. session info


# 1. Load CD8T obj, subset "NK/gdT", & prepare barcode
```{r}
# Load cd8t obj
load("/cluster/projects/xxx/scRNAseq_ALCL_FFPE/data/Seurat_objects/subclustering_2603/normal_CD8T_subclustering_res0.1.Rdata")

table(cd8t@meta.data$cd8t_celltype)
# exhausted CD8      NK / gdT TCF7+GZMA+CD8 
#         2505           984          5334 

ncol(cd8t)
# 8823


# subset NK/gdT
gdT <- subset(cd8t, subset = cd8t_celltype == "NK / gdT")
table(gdT$cd8t_celltype)
# NK / gdT 
#     984 

barcodes <- colnames(gdT)

length(barcodes) 
#[1] 984

head(barcodes)
#[1] "ALCL001_AAAGCGAAGTTACATCACAGTCTG-1" "ALCL001_ACCAATAAGTCTACCAACAGTCTG-1"
#[3] "ALCL001_ACCTAGTGTGCTCCTTACAGTCTG-1" "ALCL001_ACTACAAAGCAGCCAAACAGTCTG-1"
#[5] "ALCL001_AGCGCTAAGGCCCATTACAGTCTG-1" "ALCL001_AGCGCTAAGGTCTTGCACAGTCTG-1"
```


# 2. Normalize CD8T obj 
Normalize data: SCTransform
```{r}
# Prepare percent.mt
cd8t[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(cd8t, pattern = "^MT-")
summary(cd8t$percent.mt)
#   Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#  0.0000  0.3605  0.7227  1.2628  1.4418 15.2914 


# Normalize CD8T obj using scTransform and parameters as in the paper
cd8t <- SCTransform(cd8t,
                   method = "glmGamPoi",
                   vst.flavor = "v2",
                   variable.features.n = 3000,
                   vars.to.regress = "percent.mt",
                   return.only.var.genes = FALSE)   

# output message:
#Running SCTransform on assay: RNA
#Running SCTransform on layer: counts
#vst.flavor='v2' set. Using model with fixed slope and excluding poisson genes.
#Variance stabilizing transformation of count matrix of size 13715 by 8823
#Model formula is y ~ log_umi
#Get Negative Binomial regression parameters per gene
#Using 2000 genes, 5000 cells
#There are 49 estimated thetas smaller than 1e-07 - will be set to 1e-07
#Second step: Get residuals using fitted parameters for 13715 genes
#Computing corrected count matrix for 13715 genes
#Calculating gene attributes
#Wall clock passed: Time difference of 42.48209 secs
#Determine variable features
#...
```


# 3. Cell Cycle Scoring
NOTE: missing "ABHD17A" "TRDV1"  genes
```{r}
# 19 PreGame genes on Zenodo:
#'TYROBP', 'ASCL2', 'FCGR3A', 'FGFBP2', 'KLRC1', 'GNLY', 'CX3CR1', 'GZMB', 'PRSS23', 'ABHD17A', 'NKG7', 'PRF1', 'EMP3', 'RAP1GAP2', 'CLIC3', 'NCR3', 'FOS', 'TRDV1', 'S1PR5' 

pregame_genes <- c("TYROBP","ASCL2","FCGR3A","FGFBP2","KLRC1","GNLY","CX3CR1","GZMB",
                   "PRSS23","ABHD17A","NKG7","PRF1","EMP3","RAP1GAP2","CLIC3","NCR3",
                   "FOS","TRDV1","S1PR5")



# Check missing genes in cd8t:
SeuratObject::Assays(cd8t)
#[1] "RNA" "SCT"

missing_genes <- setdiff(pregame_genes, rownames(cd8t[["SCT"]]))
missing_genes
missing_genes %in% rownames(cd8t[["RNA"]])
#[1] "ABHD17A" "TRDV1"  
#[1] FALSE FALSE

# NOTE: "ABHD17A" "TRDV1"  are not even expressed by sc.obj_harmony (my whole, initial Seurat obj) either



# Perform Seurat's CellCycleScoring()
## newest: cc.genes.updated.2019
cd8t <- CellCycleScoring(cd8t,
                         s.features   = cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes,
                         g2m.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes)

cc <- cd8t@meta.data[barcodes, c("S.Score", "G2M.Score", "Phase")]
#Warning: The following features are not present in the object: MRPL36, not searching for symbol synonyms
#Warning: The following features are not present in the object: PIMREG, not searching for symbol synonyms

head(cc)
#                                        S.Score    G2M.Score Phase
#ALCL001_AAAGCGAAGTTACATCACAGTCTG-1 -0.031614951  0.014796847   G2M
#ALCL001_ACCAATAAGTCTACCAACAGTCTG-1 -0.005322315 -0.007494335    G1
#ALCL001_ACCTAGTGTGCTCCTTACAGTCTG-1  0.030864788  0.019872121     S
#ALCL001_ACTACAAAGCAGCCAAACAGTCTG-1 -0.022867522 -0.017007666    G1
#ALCL001_AGCGCTAAGGCCCATTACAGTCTG-1 -0.015772211 -0.001820860    G1
#ALCL001_AGCGCTAAGGTCTTGCACAGTCTG-1 -0.025609455 -0.021193931    G1

table(cc$Phase)
# G1 G2M   S 
#437 239 308 

```


# 4. Builds the expression table from the SCT assay
```{r}
pregame_present <- setdiff(pregame_genes, c("ABHD17A", "TRDV1"))
gdt <- subset(cd8t, cells = barcodes)
expr <- t(as.matrix(GetAssayData(gdt, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")[pregame_present, , drop = FALSE]))
dim(expr)
#[1] 984  17
```


# 5. Combines the expression with the barcodes and cell-cycle scores 
```{r}
out <- data.frame(Barcode   = barcodes,
                  S.Score   = cc[barcodes, "S.Score"],
                  G2M.Score = cc[barcodes, "G2M.Score"],
                  Phase     = cc[barcodes, "Phase"],
                  expr[barcodes, , drop = FALSE],
                  check.names = FALSE)

dim(out)
#[1] 984  21

sum(is.na(out))
#[1] 0

write.csv(out, "/cluster/home/xxxuhn/scRNAseq_ALCL_FFPE/results/processed/261120_PreGame_input_gdT.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
